id: W:menendez pidal|primera cronica general de espana
original_title: Primera crónica general: estoria de España que mandó componer Alfonso el Sabio y se continuaba bajo Sancho IV en 1289
note: Menéndez Pidal is the editor of the medieval chronicle, not its original author. The 1955 Gredos edition revises his 1906 edition; none of his listed candidates is this text.

original_title: Begriffsgeschichten: Studien zur Semantik und Pragmatik der politischen und sozialen Sprache
note: Spanish edition of the posthumous Begriffsgeschichten (Trotta first published it in 2012). Absent from the candidates; distinct from The Practice of Conceptual History and the 2004 article.

original_title: Θεογονία (Theogonia)
note: Hesiod’s Theogony, composed approximately around 700 BCE; no exact original year. The author field includes stray citation text. The publisher confirms Jaa Torrano’s Portuguese translation and ISBN; no candidates were supplied.

original_title: Machiavelli
note: Portuguese translation by Denise Bottmann. The candidate’s 1956 date conflicts with Skinner’s 1981 original; the local duplicate-merge record shows Skinner’s former w-279109 was merged into w-165950.

original_title: Imagined communities: reflections on the origin and spread of nationalism
note: Swedish translation by Sven-Erik Torhell of Imagined Communities; later editions retain the same work identity.

original_title: The big six: historical thinking concepts
note: Seixas and Morton’s Nelson book, not the distinct 2006 Teaching about historical thinking resource. Publisher order form confirms the ISBN.

original_title: Quel che resta di Auschwitz: l'archivio e il testimone
note: Portuguese translation by Selvino J. Assmann. Select the Italian original rather than the English translation w-282091.

original_title: “Judarnas Wagner”: Moses Pergament och den kulturella identifikationens dilemma omkring 1920–1950
note: Henrik Rosengren’s doctoral monograph, published by Sekel Bokförlag in 2007. No candidates supplied; university bibliographic record confirms language, date and ISBN.

original_title: An introduction to contemporary history
note: Portuguese translation of Barraclough’s book, first published in 1964; candidate is a later English edition dated 1965.

original_title: Faire de l'histoire. II: Nouvelles approches
note: Portuguese translation of volume II, edited jointly by Jacques Le Goff and Pierre Nora. Candidate w-234611 names the complete three-volume Faire de l’histoire, not this individual volume.

original_title: Modern tragedy
note: Portuguese translation by Betina Bischof, published by Cosac & Naify in 2002, of Modern Tragedy.

original_title: Los estratos del tiempo: estudios sobre la historia
container: Zeitschichten: Studien zur Historik (2000), selected essays
note: Spanish selection translated by Daniel Innerarity, with an introduction by Elías Palti, drawn from Zeitschichten (2000). It does not reproduce the complete German collection w-1188635.

original_title: Economia política da urbanização
note: Exact title and original publication year; the candidate’s trailing “[ensaios” is a truncated subtitle.

original_title: La formation de l'esprit scientifique: contribution à une psychanalyse de la connaissance objective
note: Portuguese translation by Estela dos Santos Abreu of the 1938 French book; publisher confirms the translation and original date.

original_title: L'atelier de l'histoire
note: Portuguese edition of L’atelier de l’histoire, issued by Gradiva in multiple volumes. Select the French original rather than English translation w-107632.

original_title: Pour une histoire culturelle
note: Portuguese translation of the collection edited by Jean-Pierre Rioux and Jean-François Sirinelli. The second cited author is truncated. Distinct from Histoire culturelle de la France and the listed 1998 article.

original_title: Nations and nationalism
note: Spanish translation of Nations and Nationalism (1983), not Gellner’s separate Nationalism (1997).

id: W:rouquie|o estado militar na america latina
original_title: L'État militaire en Amérique latine
note: Portuguese translation of the 1982 French book. Select the French original rather than English translation w-311581.

original_title: A organização nacional. Primeira parte: A constituição
note: The 1978 edition of the 1914 book, cited with a shortened title. Distinct from O problema nacional brasileiro.

original_title: Corrupção e poder no Brasil: uma história, séculos XVI a XVIII
note: Adriana Romeiro’s 2017 Autêntica book; no listed candidate matches. Publisher confirms the original Portuguese ebook ISBN and August 2017 publication.
